subject.why: Clearly depicts the requested open pouch spilling three glowing green beans with a golden glow.

category.why: Follows category 2 with a flat single-color surface and smooth gradient wall in the same warm color family.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: Centered with adequate margins on all sides and nothing cropped.

colour.why: Bright and saturated warm background providing strong contrast with the green beans.

detail.why: Smooth simplified surfaces without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Features smooth, chunky 3D volumes with a soft satin sheen matching the reference aesthetic.
